report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Angelo Lane Water Company (report date 06/30/26)

sources_described: A single well, Well CA4300578 at 3855 Canada Road, Gilroy CA 95020. The source assessment (started 2018) identified septic systems and roads as possible contaminating activities, with no actual contamination indicated.

extraction_notes: The uploaded report is a Word .docx, so page is null for every entry. Tables in document order: Table 1 coliform, Table 2 lead/copper (September 2024), Table 3 sodium/hardness, Table 4 primary standards, Table 5 secondary standards, Table 6 unregulated (1,2,3-TCP). 'Range of Detections' is 'N/A' for most rows, so range fields are null except gross alpha and manganese. Sample dates are printed as month/year ('12/25', '08/22', '08/19'); sample_year follows them. Unit anomalies copied as printed: lead in '(ppm)' with AL 15; zinc 55 '(ppm)' against SMCL 5; manganese 150 ug/l against SMCL 50 - the report's violation summary nevertheless says 'None'. Secondary MCLs are printed at the short-term limits (TDS 1500, conductance 2200, chloride/sulfate 600). The report also states VOCs including MTBE (September 2024) and 4 SOCs were tested and none detected (no table rows). Report says most tests are on a 3-, 4- or 6-year cycle.
